slides.text: 4 habits that raise your testosterone fast
save this. you'll need it at the gym
first thing: sleep. if your sleep's a mess, your hormones take the hit. aim for 7-8 hrs, no crazy late nights.
one week of dialed-in sleep and you'll feel the difference in your energy and your body.

get a lifting plan that actually adjusts to your week and your goal
try the app
second thing: your food. your body needs healthy fats to make hormones. olive oil, eggs, avocado, red meat once or twice a week.
don't live off tuna and rice all day then wonder why your levels are low.
third thing: lifting. resistance training raises testosterone hard, especially squats, deadlifts, and bench.
train 3-4 days a week, stay in the 6-8 rep range with real weight. light training doesn't get you the same result.
fourth thing: supplements that actually matter. vitamin D is huge, most guys are deficient. magnesium before bed improves sleep quality.
not magic, just fills what's missing. you'll feel the difference within weeks.
these small habits speed up your progress and change your energy, training, and body.
